paragraphs: Reunitus sells lost and found management and baggage resolution through software and managed service offerings. The offering is grouped into baggage resolution, lost item resolution, and unclaimed item monetization. Items that cannot be reunited are resold, and the company says it pays upfront based on full retail value.

NetTracer is a web-based tracing and resolution system that gained broad market adoption in North America. BagCentral launched as a baggage managed service for the airline industry, handling outsourced tasks such as baggage resolution and claims processing. Virtual services vBSO and vBagAgent were created to support airline partners.

Named partners include airlines, casinos, public venues, resorts, car rental providers, theme parks, cruise lines, and ground transportation companies. Airports and ground transportation also appear under the heading for who the company serves. The about page describes that work as streamlining lost item tracing, management, and resolution for airlines, airports, casinos, resorts, and theme parks.
